name: Baku
tagline: Grand Caspian boulevards, fast e-visas & budget arbitrage
intro: An emerging hotspot delivering European architectural grandeur at competitive rates, with 3-hour urgent e-visas and 5-star Caspian venues.
best_season: April to June, Sept to Nov
best_months: April to June and September to October
access: Direct flights from Delhi, roughly five hours.
highlights: A European-feeling city at a materially lower cost than Europe, with no Schengen process to manage.
Fast electronic visa processing, which removes the longest lead time from an international group trip.
Compact centre with walkable venues and a short airport transfer, so a three-night programme stays productive.
planning_note: Winters are cold and wet, and midsummer is hot. The shoulder seasons are genuinely better for a working programme, not just cheaper.
